blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga—Authorities arrested a Chinese allegedly connected to the massive Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) hubs in Bamban, Tarlac and Porac, Pampanga. He was apprehended during a law enforcement operation in Parañaque City on Friday, Oct. 9. In a statement, the Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) identified the foreigner as Huang Mingmin. It said investigation revealed that Huang was allegedly among the Chinese who facilitated the broader operation of Zun Yuan Technology Inc. inside the 10-hectare Baofu Land Development compound in Bamban, Tarlac.
